```{r}
#| title: "Tomorrow, €/MWh"
p <- plot_ly() |>
  add_lines(data = today_act, x = ~hour, y = ~actual,
            name = paste("Actual", format(latest - 1, "%a")),
            line = list(color = grey, width = 2, dash = "dot"),
            hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", format(latest - 1, "%a %d %b"), "</extra>")) |>
  add_lines(data = week_act, x = ~hour, y = ~actual,
            name = paste("Actual last", format(latest - 7, "%a")),
            line = list(color = "#c3c8cf", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
            hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", format(latest - 7, "%a %d %b"), "</extra>"))

# naive left out
fc_models <- setdiff(models, "naive_mix")
fc_models <- c(main, setdiff(fc_models, main))   # open on main model

for (m in fc_models) {
  d <- tomorrow |> select(hour, f = all_of(m)) |> left_join(fan_wide(m), by = "hour") |>
    mutate(range90 = ifelse(is.na(q0.05), "", sprintf(" · 9 in 10: %.0f to %.0f · half the time: %.0f to %.0f",
                                                       q0.05, q0.95, q0.25, q0.75)))
  col <- model_colors[[m]]
  vis <- m == fc_models[1]
  k <- key_hours(m)
  # always the same number of traces per model, so the model buttons can switch them
  dens <- lapply(1:3, \(i) if (!is.null(k) && i <= nrow(k)) side_xy(m, k$hour[i]) else tibble(x = NA_real_, y = NA_real_))
  dcol <- if (is.null(k)) rep("#999999", 3) else c(k$col, rep("#999999", 3))[1:3]
  lab  <- if (is.null(k)) tibble(x = NA_real_, y = NA_real_, txt = "", col = "#999999") else
    tibble(x = k$hour + 0.6, y = k$q0.95, col = k$col,
           txt = sprintf("<b>%s, %02d:00</b><br>%.0f €/MWh<br>9 in 10: %.0f to %.0f", k$what, k$hour, k$f, k$q0.05, k$q0.95))
  p <- p |>
    add_polygons(data = band_xy(m, "q0.05", "q0.95"), x = ~x, y = ~y, xaxis = "x2", fillcolor = "rgba(31,35,40,0.07)",
                 line = list(width = 0), name = "9 in 10 days inside", visible = vis, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
    add_polygons(data = band_xy(m, "q0.25", "q0.75"), x = ~x, y = ~y, xaxis = "x2", fillcolor = "rgba(31,35,40,0.13)",
                 line = list(width = 0), name = "Half the days inside", visible = vis, hoverinfo = "skip")
  for (i in 1:3) p <- p |>
    add_polygons(data = dens[[i]], x = ~x, y = ~y, xaxis = "x2", fillcolor = rgba(dcol[i], 0.22),
                 line = list(color = dcol[i], width = 1.6), showlegend = FALSE, visible = vis, hoverinfo = "skip")
  p <- p |>
    add_text(data = lab, x = ~x, y = ~y, text = ~txt, xaxis = "x2", textposition = "top right",
             textfont = list(color = ink, size = 11), showlegend = FALSE, visible = vis, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
    add_lines(data = d, x = ~hour, y = ~f, text = ~range90,
              name = paste(model_labels[[m]], format(latest, "%a %d %b")), visible = vis,
              line = list(color = ink, width = 2.6, shape = "hvh"),
              hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.0f} €/MWh%{text}<extra>", model_labels[[m]], "</extra>"))
}

p |> skip_hover() |> chart_layout(fc_models, xtitle = "Hour (Danish time)", n_fixed = 2, per_model = 7) |>
  layout(xaxis = list(dtick = 3, range = c(-0.6, 25.5)),
         xaxis2 = list(overlaying = "x", matches = "x", visible = FALSE),
         yaxis = list(range = { r <- range(unlist(lapply(fc_models, \(m) unlist(fan_wide(m)[c("q0.05", "q0.95")]))),
                                              unlist(tomorrow[fc_models]), today_act$actual, week_act$actual, na.rm = TRUE)
                                c(r[1] - 0.05 * diff(r), r[2] + 0.22 * diff(r)) }))
```

## Row {height=56%}

```{r}
#| title: "Live forecast vs actual, €/MWh. Red/blue: outside the 90% range"
if (nrow(scored) == 0) {
  cat("The track record starts once the first forecast day has passed.")
} else {
  sc <- scored |> mutate(time = as_datetime(date, tz = "Europe/Copenhagen") + hours(hour))
  blank <- tibble(time = sc$time[1], y = NA_real_, y2 = NA_real_)

  # gaps between the actual price and the 90% range, as closed shapes, one per run of hours
  gap_shapes <- function(t, edge, a) {
    r <- rle(!is.na(edge))
    ends <- cumsum(r$lengths)
    out <- lapply(which(r$values), \(k) {
      i <- (ends[k] - r$lengths[k] + 1):ends[k]
      if (length(i) == 1) i <- c(i, i)   # one hour: a sliver around the point
      tibble(time = c(t[i], rev(t[i]), NA), y = c(edge[i], rev(a[i]), NA))
    })
    if (length(out) == 0) blank["time"] |> mutate(y = NA_real_) else bind_rows(out)
  }

  p2 <- plot_ly(sc, x = ~time) |>
    add_lines(y = ~actual, name = "Actual", line = list(color = ink, width = 1.5),
              hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>Actual</extra>")

  bar_w <- 0.6 * 86400000
  for (m in models) {
    vis <- m == models[1]
    col <- model_colors[[m]]
    b <- sc |> select(date, hour, time, actual, f = all_of(m))
    b <- if (!is.null(bands[[m]])) left_join(b, bands[[m]], by = c("date", "hour")) else mutate(b, o0.05 = NA_real_, o0.95 = NA_real_)
    b <- b |> mutate(lo = f + o0.05, hi = f + o0.95,
                     above = ifelse(!is.na(hi) & actual > hi, hi, NA), below = ifelse(!is.na(lo) & actual < lo, lo, NA))
    up <- gap_shapes(b$time, b$above, b$actual)
    dn <- gap_shapes(b$time, b$below, b$actual)
    days <- b |> group_by(date) |>
      summarise(up = sum(!is.na(above)), dn = -sum(!is.na(below)), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(time = as_datetime(date, tz = "Europe/Copenhagen") + hours(12))
    p2 <- p2 |>
      add_lines(data = b, x = ~time, y = ~lo, line = list(width = 0), showlegend = FALSE, visible = vis,
                hoverinfo = "skip") |>
      add_lines(data = b, x = ~time, y = ~hi, line = list(width = 0), fill = "tonexty",
                fillcolor = "rgba(107,114,128,0.12)", name = "90% range", visible = vis, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
      add_polygons(data = up, x = ~time, y = ~y, fillcolor = "rgba(220,38,38,0.45)", line = list(width = 0),
                   name = "Above the range", visible = vis, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
      add_polygons(data = dn, x = ~time, y = ~y, fillcolor = "rgba(42,157,143,0.45)", line = list(width = 0),
                   name = "Below the range", visible = vis, hoverinfo = "skip") |>
      add_bars(data = days, x = ~time, y = ~up, yaxis = "y2", width = bar_w, marker = list(color = "#dc2626"),
               showlegend = FALSE, visible = vis, hovertemplate = "%{y} hours above<extra></extra>") |>
      add_bars(data = days, x = ~time, y = ~dn, yaxis = "y2", width = bar_w, marker = list(color = "#2a9d8f"),
               showlegend = FALSE, visible = vis, hovertemplate = "%{customdata} hours below<extra></extra>",
               customdata = ~-dn) |>
      add_lines(data = b, x = ~time, y = ~f, name = model_labels[[m]], visible = vis,
                line = list(color = col, width = 1.5),
                hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", model_labels[[m]], "</extra>"))
  }

  p2 |> chart_layout(models, per_model = 7) |>
    layout(yaxis = list(domain = c(0.3, 1)), barmode = "relative",
           yaxis2 = list(domain = c(0, 0.22), anchor = "x", title = list(text = "Hours outside", font = list(size = 11)),
                         color = grey, gridcolor = "#eceef1", zerolinecolor = "#c3c8cf"))
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Error by model, live (€/MWh, lower is better)"
acc_live <- bind_rows(lapply(models, \(m) {
  s <- scored[!is.na(scored[[m]]), ]
  if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble(m = m, model = model_labels[[m]], mae = mean(abs(s$actual - s[[m]])), bias = mean(s$actual - s[[m]]),
         pct = 100 * mean(abs(s$actual - s[[m]])) / mean(abs(s$actual)))
}))
if (nrow(acc_live) > 0) {
  a <- acc_live |> arrange(desc(mae)) |> mutate(model = factor(model, model))
  plot_ly(a, y = ~model, x = ~mae, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = unname(unlist(model_colors[a$m]))),
          text = ~sprintf("%.0f · %.0f%% of price", mae, pct), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE,
          hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x:.1f} €/MWh<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "", range = c(0, max(a$mae) * 1.45), gridcolor = "#eceef1"), yaxis = list(title = ""),
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 5, b = 25), paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           font = list(color = grey)) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Bias: actual minus forecast (+ = forecast too low)"
if (nrow(acc_live) > 0) {
  a <- acc_live |> arrange(desc(mae)) |> mutate(model = factor(model, model))
  lim <- max(abs(a$bias), 10) * 1.5
  plot_ly(a, y = ~model, x = ~bias, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = ifelse(abs(a$bias) <= 5, "#16a34a", ifelse(abs(a$bias) <= 12, "#f59e0b", "#dc2626"))),
          text = ~sprintf("%+.0f", bias), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE,
          hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x:+.1f} €/MWh<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "", range = c(-lim, lim), zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = ink, zerolinewidth = 2, gridcolor = "#eceef1"),
           yaxis = list(title = ""),
           shapes = list(list(type = "rect", x0 = -5, x1 = 5, y0 = -0.5, y1 = nrow(a) - 0.5, fillcolor = "rgba(22,163,74,0.08)", line = list(width = 0), layer = "below")),
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 5, b = 25), paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           font = list(color = grey)) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

::: {.card title="Challengers: tested live before they can replace the ensemble"}

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(chall) && nrow(chall) > 0) {
  arrow <- function(a, b) ifelse(is.na(a), "\u2013", sprintf("%.1f \u2192 %.1f", a, b))
  ch_tab <- chall |>
    transmute(Challenger      = label,
              `Live days`     = live_days,
              `Live MAE`      = arrow(live_mae_champion, live_mae_challenger),
              `Live p (Holm)` = ifelse(is.na(live_p_holm), "\u2013", p_tab(live_p_holm)),
              Status          = status)
  if (nrow(chall) == 1) names(ch_tab)[names(ch_tab) == "Live p (Holm)"] <- "Live p"
  cat(knitr::kable(ch_tab, format = "html", align = "lrrrl",
                   table.attr = 'class="table table-sm table-striped small"'))
  cat("\n\nMAE: ensemble \u2192 challenger, €/MWh. ", chall_txt, "\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Row {height=640px}

::: {.card title="How it works"}

**Forecast.** Tomorrow's hourly prices (the average of the four quarter-hours), made at about 10:15 the day before and never changed.

**Models.** Four forecasts are made every morning and compared: BMT-X (boosting with multiple testing, from my thesis), LEAR-X (a lasso per hour), XGBoost-X, and the ensemble, their average, which is the headline forecast. Benchmark: the weekly naive. Re-estimated every day on the last two years.

**Inputs.** Only data published before the noon auction. The list is in `inputs.csv`, and the dashboard won't build if the forecast uses anything else.

```{r}
#| output: asis
used <- inputs_reg[inputs_reg$status == "used", ]
cat(knitr::kable(data.frame(Input = used$input, Source = used$source, Published = used$published),
                 format = "html", table.attr = 'class="table table-sm small"'))
testing <- inputs_reg[grepl("^testing", inputs_reg$status), ]
if (nrow(testing)) cat("\n\nBeing tested: ", paste0(testing$input, " (", sub("^testing: ", "", testing$status), ")", collapse = "; "), ".", sep = "")
dropped <- inputs_reg[grepl("^dropped", inputs_reg$status), ]
cat("\n\nTried and dropped: ", paste0(dropped$input, " (", sub("^dropped: ", "", dropped$status), ")", collapse = "; "), ".\n", sep = "")
```

**Ranges.** 5% and 95% quantiles from each model's recent errors. The chance of a negative price comes from the same quantiles.

**Challengers.** Changes run live next to the ensemble and only replace it if they win on a rule set in advance. Prices rose with gas in autumn 2026, and the models, trained on two years of cheaper gas, came in too low. Since 11 Nov a gas correction runs, and since 12 Nov the same three models with the gas price as an input. In the backtest, gas inside the models cut the ensemble's error by 3.3% (p = 0.002) and its bias from 6.0 to 3.9 €/MWh; a 28-day bias correction on top took the rest.

**Data:** [Energi Data Service](https://www.energidataservice.dk) (Energinet).<br>
**Code:** [github.com/jacobazu/dk1-price-forecasting](https://github.com/jacobazu/dk1-price-forecasting)<br>
**Last updated:** `r format(with_tz(Sys.time(), "Europe/Copenhagen"), "%d %B %Y, %H:%M")` (Danish time)

:::
